Amalgamated Financial Corp / Amalgamated Bank is a $8.9B in assets regional bank regulated by FDIC (Cert 413), Federal Reserve (Fed ID 661308), NYSDFS, operating since 1923 with 581 employees. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.6/5. The deepest capability gap is Service Process Configuration & Routing at 1.9/5 against a 2.7 peer median [E-044, E-050]. Next is Behavior-Based Rewards at 2.1/5 against a 2.8 peer median. Third is Document Chunking & Metadata Enrichment Pipelines at 2.3/5 against a 2.7 peer median [E-023].

The issue register adds 24 subcaps (baseline-scored categories: M&A integration, BaaS, innovation labs, RAG, fraud intelligence) had empty evidence_ids fields (critical severity). The issue register adds 8 evidence IDs cited in scoring subcaps not present in evidence_index.csv (E-034, E-045, E-050, E-051, E-057) (critical severity). Counter-signal: ESG Roadmap already runs at 3.4/5 against a 2.6 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [E-002, E-006, E-007]. The roster shows no CISO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below.

The question for Amalgamated Financial Corp / Amalgamated Bank is whether to close Service Process Configuration & Routing first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Amalgamated Financial Corp / Amalgamated Bank should lead with nCino (65/100 fit) against Strategic Integration Planning, then sequence Salesforce behind it. Closing Service Process Configuration & Routing to the peer median alone is worth 0.8 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
